integrity: Proof supplied with exact polynomial telescoping identity, integer recurrence, local valuation analysis and a standard-library finite sanity checker. No independent audit or formal verification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies GCDs of sums of consecutive third powers of the ordinary Fibonacci sequence. It does not cover arbitrary Gibonacci initial pairs or cubes of Lucas numbers. Literature comparisons cannot rule out unindexed equivalent work; finite test data are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
title: Exact GCDs of consecutive cubic Fibonacci windows
